summary: This is a prospectus supplement filed by NatWest Group plc under Rule 424(b)(5) for a $1.25 billion issuance of 4.983% senior callable fixed-to-fixed reset rate notes due 2032. The notes are direct, unsecured, unsubordinated obligations ranking pari passu with other unsecured debt. The issuer may redeem the notes at par on the optional redemption date or upon certain tax/regulatory events. The filing is a routine debt offering and does not constitute a special situation under any defined category.
